# Archipel artwork

The README uses `archipel-hero-v2.png`, a 2172 × 724 opaque PNG generated on 2026-11-03 with the built-in Imagegen tool. It preserves the established island-cluster mark and connected backend-capability islands, presented as light ceramic and glass with turquoise and coral accents. This is original brand illustration, not a screenshot or a literal deployment diagram.

`project-card.webp` is the matching 960 × 540 portfolio image. Its English/German descriptions, alternative text and generation prompt live in `project-card.json`. The earlier `archipel-hero.png` is retained as legacy artwork. The repository's license applies to these project assets.

## Hero generation prompt

```text
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset: refreshed Archipel README hero, wide 3:1 landscape banner, target 2400x800.
Input: the supplied Archipel card is the exact approved concept and identity. KEEP the archipelago idea, established turquoise/coral/ivory cluster mark and connected backend-capability islands. Adapt it into a wide README banner in the same bright ceramic/glass material family as the new Synapse artwork.
LEFT THIRD: the existing small turquoise/coral/ivory island-cluster mark and large exact BLACK word "Archipel" with clear generous whitespace. Same confident sans-serif family and visual hierarchy as the supplied card.
RIGHT TWO THIRDS: a refined modular archipelago of gently layered ivory ceramic platforms with turquoise and coral insets, connected with slender clear-glass arcs and small junction dots. The central coral island has a simple database-cylinder relief; outer islands have a restrained shield, envelope, plug and cog or people relief. Keep all main islands fully within the banner and a 7% safe margin. Soft grounded studio shadows, precise tactile surfaces, shallow elevated camera and very light warm-white seamless background. All five islands remain readable at 1200px width.
This is original editorial brand artwork for modular NestJS backend libraries, not a screenshot, security guarantee or literal deployment diagram. Only text: "Archipel". No tagline, additional prose, badges, vendor logos, dark/navy background, neon, mechanical machines, generic AI symbols, watermarks or unrelated decorations.
Preserve the character of the supplied card and the clarity of the existing Archipel concept; change the presentation to a calm, light, high-quality material illustration.
```
